subject: POC kickoff: reschedule & final checklist
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acme.com>, Dana Li <dana.li@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff: scheduling & environment checklist

Hi Alex/Dana,

Great to meet you last week excited to get the POC kicked off. We'd like to schedule a 60-90 minute hands-on session where we can:
- Walk through prompt review and routing config
- Run a few load tests (low RPS smoke and one higher-throughput test)
- Validate staging endpoints, API keys, and VPC allowlist

Proposed slots (PT):
- Fri 10/3, 10:00-11:30
- Mon 10/6, 09:00-10:30 or 14:00-15:30

Can you confirm which works, and whether you have any SRE/infra folks who should join for the allowlist/load-test portion?

To help prep, please provision the following before the session if possible:
- Add our staging IPs to your VPC allowlist (template attached)
- Provision a sandbox API key with ``sandbox:read,sandbox:write`` scope (we can rotate keys post-POC)
- Provide a staging endpoint URL or confirmation we can use redwood staging for the tests

I've attached our POC runbook and a network allowlist template. Dev is on this thread to provide exact IPs and the staging endpoint.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0147

Attachments: POC-runbook.pdf, network-allowlist-template.csv

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Oct 2025 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff: scheduling & environment checklist

Hi Marissa - thanks, this looks good.

We can do a 90-minute session; FWIW that will help us get through routing and a couple of load scenarios. Fri 10/3 conflicts for us. Mon 10/6 at 14:00 PT would work better.

Quick questions to help prep our infra team:
- Can you provide the exact IPs (or CIDR ranges) we need to allowlist?
- What is the expected max RPS for the higher-throughput test (so we can provision test resources)?
- Are there token scope requirements or specific headers we need to include in requests?

Looping in Dana (SRE) - Dana, would you and/or someone from infra want to join the call?

Thanks,
Alex Turner
Senior Product Manager, Acme Corp
alex.turner@acme.com

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acme.com>, Dana Li <dana.li@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Oct 2025 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff: scheduling & environment checklist

Alex/Dana - quick technical details to unblock allowlisting and sandbox access.

1) Allowlist IPs (egress from Redwood staging):
- 35.199.120.45/32
- 35.199.121.12/32
- 34.122.210.0/24 (for burst/load test nodes)

2) Staging endpoint: https://staging-api.redwood.ai/acme (TLS cert is public)

3) Sandbox API key (example stub) - we will create a scoped key for your account before the session. Example header: Authorization: Bearer sk-sandbox-acme-XXXX
Required scopes: sandbox.read, sandbox.generate, sandbox.logs

4) Load-test guidance: start with 5 RPS smoke for 5 minutes, then ramp to 40 RPS for 3 minutes for the higher-throughput verification. If you'd like to push harder we can coordinate limits; please advise target RPS and any concurrency constraints.

5) Prompt/routing note: during the session we'll show both a single-model routing and a staged fallback routing setup to handle capacity constraints. If you have specific prompt templates, please share them ahead of time.

I've attached a short sandbox-setup.txt with step-by-step instructions and included the network-allowlist-template.csv in the original thread.

-Dev
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: sandbox-setup.txt

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acme.com>, Dana Li <dana.li@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Oct 2025 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff: scheduling & environment checklist

Perfect - thanks Dev. Alex/Dana, we'll pencil in Mon 10/6 at 14:00 PT for 90 minutes and send a calendar invite; if you prefer Mon morning we can try to adjust but please confirm.

Action items before the session:
- Acme: add the IPs above to your allowlist (Dev's template attached)
- Acme: provision the sandbox API key (Dev will issue a scoped key)
- Acme: share any prompt examples you want us to review during the session

We'll prepare a quick routing demo + one load test as described. If Dana is able to join, we'll run the allowlist verification first.

I'll share the invite in a follow-up.

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dana Li <dana.li@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Oct 2025 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff: scheduling & environment checklist

Heads up - we have a conflict on Mon 10/6. Could we move to Wed 10/8 or Fri 10/5 instead? Prefer Fri 10/5, 14:00 PT if that works (Dana can do Fri).

Also: for the ramp test we'd like to validate up to 80 RPS for a short burst; are there any account-level limits we should be aware of? If so, what's the recommended approach to temporarily raise them for the POC?

We'll try to get the allowlist added by EOD Monday.

Thanks,
Alex

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acme.com>, Dana Li <dana.li@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 Oct 2025 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff: scheduling & environment checklist

Alex - thanks for the heads up. Fri 10/5 at 14:00 PT works for us; I've updated the invite (link below) - please accept when you can.

Load test limits: we can support an 80 RPS short burst for the POC. Please note:
- We'll schedule the high-RPS test as a controlled exercise and ask Acme to confirm exact window at least 24 hours in advance.
- If you expect sustained high throughput we recommend a dedicated capacity path later, but for POC bursts we're fine with a short increase.

Pre-POC checklist (please try to complete by Thu 10/4):
- Add allowlist IPs (see template)
- Confirm sandbox API key is provisioned and share the key via a secure channel
- Share any prompt examples to review

I've attached an updated POC runbook with timing and a calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=acme-poc-kickoff-20251005-1400

Looking forward to it - see you Fri 10/5 at 14:00 PT.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: updated-poc-runbook.pdf
